paragraphs.text: The wall between design and code was always a staffing decision.
Products rarely broke in the design file or in the repo. They broke in the gap between them, where a spec became a ticket and a detail became a nice-to-have.
That gap is closing from both sides.
found designers working in development doubled to 41% in a year, while developers doing design climbed to 60%.
found half of designers now ship code to production.
Crossing the line is not the same as owning what sits on the other side. At
, every designer shipped a pull request within a month, and engineers reviewed each one like any other code.
That is the model. Anyone starts. The expert signs off.
An engineer's rough screen gets a designer's finish. A designer's pull request gets an engineer's review. Nobody rebuilds a copy of anyone's work.
Start anywhere. Ship through the owner.
